title: BEIKE NLP at SemEval-2022 Task 4: Prompt-based Paragraph Classification for Patronizing and Condescending Language Detection

bias_targets.methodology: Detecting Patronizing and Condescending Language (PCL) by reformulating paragraph classification into a masked language modeling problem, utilizing prompt-based learning with a fine-tuned DeBERTa model for binary and multi-label categorization.
